task: Write the practitioner decision-problem statement and analytics contract
reason: Every later metric must trace to a decision a Health Promotion Practitioner actually makes; without this the priority score is untethered
output: docs/DS01_analytics_contract.md defining the 7 drill-down levels and what each answers
method: Decision-to-metric mapping table
validation: Studio mentor confirms each level maps to a real practitioner question
kpi: 7/7 drill-down levels have a named metric and a named user decision
definition_of_done: Reviewed by mentor; committed

task: Baseline the current practitioner workflow (status quo)
reason: The control condition for the user study must be the real status quo, not a strawman
output: docs/DS01_status_quo.md + screenshot of the raw-file workflow
method: Contextual inquiry / walkthrough
validation: Practitioner or mentor agrees the description is fair
kpi: Status quo documented with time estimate for the control task
definition_of_done: Control task materials assembled

task: Complete data source register
reason: Provenance is the foundation of the acquisition rubric criterion
output: Register with all 7 sources, licences and limitations
method: Publisher documentation review
validation: Every URL resolves; every licence recorded; UNVERIFIED fields explicitly marked
kpi: 7/7 sources registered; 0 unmarked assumptions
definition_of_done: All non-TO_FILL fields evidenced by a citation

task: Complete data compatibility matrix with GREEN/AMBER/RED
reason: Prevents the silent-wrong-join failure mode; this is the single highest-value document in the project
method: Pairwise grain/geography/time assessment
validation: Every AMBER has a named transformation and a named validation test
kpi: 0 pairs unclassified; 0 RED reclassified without a documented decision record
definition_of_done: Reviewed; RED items have refusal rationale

task: Record licence and AEDC Data Guidelines compliance check
reason: AEDC re-display conditions may constrain what the product can show at all
method: Document review
validation: Named clause cited for each permitted display
kpi: Compliance position stated for all 7 sources
definition_of_done: Team informed of any display constraints

task: Profile AEDC SA2 file
reason: Resolves the four unknowns that control the entire design
method: pandas-profiling / custom profile; manual read of notes sheet
validation: Row/column counts, dtype table, duplicate check, suppression encoding identified
kpi: 4/4 open questions (Q1-Q4) resolved or escalated
definition_of_done: Denominator availability answered YES or NO in writing

task: Profile SEIFA, Census and ASGS
reason: Establishes join feasibility and the analysable SA2 population
method: Same profiling harness
validation: Unique-ID assertion per file; missingness quantified
kpi: 3/3 profiled; Victorian SA2 count established
definition_of_done: Analysable n recorded - this number gates model selection

task: Quantify AEDC suppression and its geographic pattern
reason: Suppression that concentrates in rural or small SA2s is a representation bias, not just missing data
method: Choropleth of suppressed SA2s; chi-square or logistic test of suppression against remoteness and population
validation: Test assumptions checked before reporting
kpi: Suppression rate by remoteness class reported
definition_of_done: Map produced; systematic exclusion assessed

task: Build cleaning module with before/after logging
reason: Cleaning without a log is unevidenced; the rubric asks for the journey not the CSV
method: Declarative cleaning steps, each emitting a before/after record count and value summary
validation: Every step logged; no step changes row count without an assertion
kpi: 100% of cleaning steps logged
definition_of_done: Log shows before/after for every operation

task: Implement suppression-preserving missing-value handling
reason: Silently imputing a suppressed child-health value would be a serious methodological error
output: Quality-flagged long table with SUPPRESSED as a distinct state
method: Three-state encoding: value / missing / suppressed
validation: Unit test asserts suppressed never becomes NaN and never becomes a number
kpi: 0 suppressed values imputed anywhere in the pipeline
definition_of_done: Test in tests/ passing

task: Load and validate ASGS Edition 3 geometry
reason: Geographic backbone; also the highest-consequence configuration decision in the project
method: GeoPandas load; make_valid; CRS assertion; special-purpose SA2 exclusion
validation: Assert all geometries valid; assert CRS; assert excluded codes logged not dropped
kpi: 0 invalid geometries; excluded SA2s listed
definition_of_done: Edition 3 confirmed in file metadata

task: Run the geography decision process and document rejected alternatives
reason: Rubric rewards demonstrated judgement; showing why SA1 and SA3 were rejected is worth more than asserting SA2
method: Constraint table: which datasets support which level; information-loss estimate per level
validation: Each rejection has a data-based reason, not a preference
kpi: 4 candidate levels assessed; 1 selected; 3 rejections evidenced
definition_of_done: ADR committed with date and decision owner

task: Build population-weighted zonal statistics function
reason: Area-weighted environmental means are not exposure measures; this function is the core geospatial contribution
input: Mesh Block populations; SA2 geometry; raster/grid
method: Rasterise MB population to the analysis grid; weighted mean/count per SA2 in EPSG:3577
validation: Unit test on a synthetic raster with known answer; compare weighted vs unweighted on real data
kpi: Weighted-vs-unweighted divergence quantified and reported
definition_of_done: Synthetic-case test passing

task: Write temporal compatibility policy
reason: Prevents implying that 2021 Census and 2024 AEDC are contemporaneous
output: docs/DS06_temporal_policy.md with a lag table per source pair
method: Explicit lag accounting; define the environmental exposure window from the AEDC birth cohort
validation: Every indicator carries reference_period in the database
kpi: Lag stated for all 6 source pairs
definition_of_done: Policy referenced by the API metadata endpoint

task: Run AEDC 2021 temporal sensitivity replication
reason: If conclusions flip when using the exactly-contemporaneous 2021 cycle, the 2024 result is fragile and you need to know before the demo
method: Re-run full priority and matching pipeline on 2021; Spearman rank correlation and top-k overlap of results
validation: Rank correlation reported with CI
kpi: Top-20 overlap between 2021 and 2024 runs reported
definition_of_done: Result reported whether favourable or not

task: Build the feature register
reason: Prevents leakage and makes every feature's purpose auditable
output: config/features.yaml with the 15 specified fields per feature
method: Declarative registry; used_for_matching and used_for_environment_comparison are mutually exclusive flags
validation: Automated test asserts no feature has both flags true
kpi: 0 features flagged for both matching and environmental comparison
definition_of_done: Leakage test passing in CI

task: Engineer heat indicator with a cited threshold
reason: Arbitrary thresholds are the classic weak point; a cited standard is defensible
method: Compute both a fixed-threshold count and a relative TX90p-style percentile index; select with documented rationale
validation: Plausibility range assertion; compare the two definitions' SA2 rankings
kpi: Rank correlation between the two threshold definitions reported
definition_of_done: Threshold citation present; both variants retained for sensitivity

task: Engineer vegetation indicator masked to populated area
reason: Unmasked vegetation share measures farmland, which would produce a misleading product
method: Class-to-vegetated mapping documented; mask to populated Mesh Blocks
validation: Correlate masked-unmasked difference with SA2 area to demonstrate the fringe artefact
kpi: Both variants computed; divergence figure produced
definition_of_done: Class mapping documented before computation

task: Test H1-H7 as stated hypotheses
reason: EDA that answers hypotheses reads as science; decorative charts read as filler
output: reports/DS08_eda_report.md with one figure per hypothesis
method: Appropriate test per hypothesis; assumptions checked and stated
validation: Assumption checks reported alongside each test
kpi: 7/7 hypotheses answered with a stated verdict
definition_of_done: Each hypothesis has a written conclusion including null results

task: Multicollinearity and redundancy analysis of matching features
reason: Correlated matching features distort distance metrics; this directly justifies the Mahalanobis decision later
method: Pearson/Spearman matrix; VIF; PCA scree for reference
validation: VIF threshold stated in advance
kpi: Final matching feature set justified by VIF and domain reasoning
definition_of_done: Feature set reduced with documented rationale

task: Spatial autocorrelation assessment (Moran's I)
reason: Treating adjacent SA2s as independent would invalidate the residual model's inference
output: Global and Local Moran's I + LISA cluster map
method: Queen contiguity weights; permutation inference
validation: Weights matrix construction documented; permutation count stated
kpi: Moran's I reported with p-value; decision on spatial CV recorded
definition_of_done: Result explicitly feeds the model validation strategy

task: Compare 6 candidate priority methods against stated criteria
reason: Choosing the simplest adequate method, with the comparison documented, is stronger evidence than deploying the fanciest
method: Assess A-F on interpretability, sensitivity, missing-data behaviour, bias risk
validation: Each method scored against pre-stated criteria
kpi: 6/6 candidates assessed; selection justified
definition_of_done: Rejected methods documented with reasons

task: Implement priority V0 (percentile overlap) then V1 (SEIFA-residual)
reason: V0 reproduces a disadvantage map; V1 finds off-trend areas. The move from V0 to V1 IS the model evolution evidence
method: V0: count of indicators past a stated percentile. V1: model AEDC on socioeconomic features, rank by residual
validation: Compare V0 and V1 top-20 overlap; show V0 correlates ~1:1 with IRSD
kpi: Correlation of V0 with IRSD reported as the trigger for V1
definition_of_done: Both versions runnable; transition documented

task: Priority weight and threshold sensitivity
reason: If top-20 changes under a 10 percent weight perturbation, the result is not decision-grade
method: Perturb weights, thresholds and scalers; Spearman rho and top-k Jaccard
validation: Number of perturbation runs stated
kpi: Top-20 Jaccard stability reported; unstable SA2s flagged in the product
definition_of_done: Unstable results surfaced to the user, not hidden

task: Build explainability output for every priority result
reason: Level 2-4 of the drill-down; also the trust mechanism in the user study
output: Per-SA2 contribution table: indicator, value, reference, percentile, direction, contribution, source, year, quality flag
method: For V1: SHAP values on the residual model, reconciled against the arithmetic
validation: Assert contributions reconcile to the reported score within tolerance
kpi: 100% of displayed priority results have a complete contribution breakdown
definition_of_done: Reconciliation test passing

task: Write the association-not-causation interface language
reason: The scientific boundary must live in the product, not only in the report
output: Standard caveat strings in config, surfaced by the API
method: Controlled vocabulary from the project's permitted-terms list
validation: Text review against the prohibited-terms list
kpi: 0 prohibited terms in any user-facing string
definition_of_done: Automated string test in CI

task: Implement matching M0 (Euclidean KNN) as a deliberate baseline
reason: You need a documented starting point for the evolution narrative, and its failures are the evidence
method: Unscaled Euclidean KNN, k=1
validation: Compute standardised mean differences on all covariates
kpi: SMD reported for all matching covariates
definition_of_done: Baseline balance recorded, including its failures

task: M1 scaled, M2 Mahalanobis, M3 stratified + caliper
reason: Unstratified matching pairs Cairns with Hobart and rediscovers climate zone, not a health signal
method: M1: standardised Euclidean. M2: Mahalanobis. M3: exact-match on GCCSA and remoteness, then Mahalanobis with a caliper
validation: SMD, match coverage, and distance distribution for each version
kpi: SMD < stated threshold on all covariates for the selected version
definition_of_done: Comparison table across M0-M3 committed

task: Define and implement NO SUITABLE MATCH
reason: Returning a bad match is worse than returning none; supporting refusal is a real quality decision
output: Caliper threshold + refusal path in the API
method: Distance caliper set from the distance distribution, stated in advance
validation: Count and map SA2s with no acceptable match
kpi: Percentage of SA2s with no suitable match reported
definition_of_done: Refusal state rendered in the UI

task: Compare outcome-difference methods and document rejections
reason: With n in the low hundreds, Isolation Forest and LOF are likely unstable; rejecting them with evidence is worth more than using them
method: Compare absolute difference, standardised difference, peer residual, regression residual, LOF, Isolation Forest
validation: Stability under resampling for each method
kpi: Stability score reported per method; rejections justified
definition_of_done: At least one method formally rejected with evidence

task: Apply the AEDC critical-difference test to matched-pair comparisons
reason: A 32 percent vs 21 percent gap may be noise at SA2 child counts; this is the difference between a defensible and an indefensible product claim
output: Significance flag on every pair comparison
method: AEDC published critical-difference method, or CIs from counts
validation: Assert no comparison is displayed without a significance state
kpi: 100% of displayed pair comparisons carry an uncertainty state
definition_of_done: Blocked if DS-03.1 finds no denominators - escalate then

task: Compute environmental difference signature per matched pair
reason: Level 7 of the drill-down; the product's core claim
output: Ranked difference table: absolute, percentage, standardised, percentile
method: Standardised difference ranking
validation: Assert environmental features were excluded from matching (leakage test)
kpi: Leakage test passing; differences ranked
definition_of_done: Signature reproducible from a run manifest

task: Flag differences below the data's effective resolution
reason: A 1.9 degree heat difference between neighbouring metropolitan SA2s is below what a 5 km grid can resolve; presenting it uncritically undermines the whole quality argument
method: Compare the difference magnitude against the indicator's stated uncertainty
validation: Flag rule stated before computation
kpi: All environmental differences carry a resolution-adequacy state
definition_of_done: Flag visible in the UI

task: Produce the 11 planned production visualisations
reason: Presentation is 10 points and visualisation is a named MDS component
method: Matplotlib/Plotly for reports; the register documents user question, encoding, misinterpretation risk, accessibility
validation: Colour-blind safe palette check; no colour-only encoding
kpi: 11/11 visuals have a register entry
definition_of_done: Each figure answers a named user question

task: Define and execute the validation strategy per model type
reason: Chasing a generic 80 percent accuracy on a non-classification problem would signal weak judgement
method: Spatial block cross-validation for the residual model given Moran's I; balance metrics for matching; stability for ranking
validation: Justify each metric against its model type
kpi: Metric choice justified for 3 model families
definition_of_done: No inappropriate metric reported anywhere

task: Full sensitivity suite across 8 axes
reason: Directly serves the requirement-refinement criterion and protects against a demo-day surprise
method: Weight, threshold, scaler, feature, geographic, temporal, missing-data and matching-method sensitivity
validation: Each axis reports rank correlation and top-k stability
kpi: 8/8 axes tested; unstable outputs flagged in-product
definition_of_done: Instability disclosed rather than suppressed

task: Bias and representation analysis
reason: Named rubric concern (minimal bias) and a genuine ethical obligation for a child-health product
method: Coverage by remoteness, population size and SEIFA decile; test whether missingness is spatially concentrated
validation: Statistical test with assumptions stated
kpi: Coverage rate reported by remoteness class and IRSD decile
definition_of_done: Systematic exclusions named and mapped

task: Assess whether SEIFA dominates the analytics
reason: If everything reduces to disadvantage, the product's claimed innovation fails
output: Variance-explained analysis of IRSD across outputs
method: Partial correlation; compare V0 and V1 dependence on IRSD
validation: Reported as a number, not an assurance
kpi: IRSD's share of explained variance reported for V0 and V1
definition_of_done: Finding drives a design decision either way

task: Run the controlled user evaluation
reason: 20 rubric points; the dimension DS students most often under-evidence. Needs calendar time, so it cannot be left to the final week
method: Within-subject: control task (raw files) then KinderPrint task; measure time, confidence, explanation completeness, trust, limitation awareness
validation: Pre-register measures and scoring rubric before running; do not fabricate any result
kpi: n participants stated; all 7 measures reported with actual data
definition_of_done: Results reported as observed, including negative findings

task: Feed user findings back into a model or interface change
reason: This is what converts a user study into model-evolution evidence rather than an appendix
output: At least one documented V(n) to V(n+1) change traceable to user feedback
method: Traceable requirement change record
validation: Change linked to a specific participant finding
kpi: At least 1 model or interface version triggered by user evidence
definition_of_done: Trigger, change and effect all recorded

task: Maintain the model evolution log continuously
reason: Retrofitting this at the end is obvious to markers and loses the criterion
method: One entry per version: requirement, method, features, params, evaluation, feedback, problem, change, reason, result
validation: Entry created in the same commit as the model change
kpi: 1 log entry per model version, 0 retrospective entries
definition_of_done: Git history corroborates the log dates

task: Build the automated refresh pipeline
reason: Named KPI in the unit spec and a handover requirement
method: Config-driven stages with logging, failure handling and a data-quality report per run
validation: Successful rerun from raw with no manual intervention
kpi: Pipeline completes; duration and stage pass rates logged
definition_of_done: Demonstrated rerun recorded

task: Define honest pipeline KPIs
reason: The unit's example KPI of 95 percent data accuracy is not measurable here; substituting measurable metrics is itself evidence of judgement
method: Schema compliance %, valid-value %, join coverage %, duplicate rate, missingness %, test pass rate, refresh success
validation: Each KPI computed automatically per run
kpi: 7 KPIs computed and trended across runs
definition_of_done: KPI definitions justified against why accuracy does not apply

task: Monitoring and drift report
reason: Handover requirement; shows the work survives the team
method: Track data version, model version, schema drift, missingness drift, match quality, priority distribution
validation: Baseline snapshot stored for comparison
kpi: 6 monitored signals with baselines
definition_of_done: Next team can detect a schema change without reading the code

task: What-if feasibility research and refusal criteria
reason: Designing the conditions under which the system must say evidence is insufficient is stronger than building a speculative simulator
method: Three-layer design; evidence grading for the pathway library; explicit refusal rule
validation: Each pathway entry carries source, population, direction, uncertainty, applicability
kpi: Refusal criteria defined before any implementation
definition_of_done: No numeric health outcome estimated without stated evidence

task: Score and rank future opportunities
reason: Rubric asks for feasibility analysis, not a wish list
output: Scored matrix: user value, data availability, scientific validity, feasibility, explainability, privacy risk, bias risk, effort
method: Weighted scoring with stated weights
validation: Scores justified per candidate
kpi: At least 10 opportunities scored and ranked
definition_of_done: Top 3 have concrete next-step data requirements

task: Write the model card
reason: Consolidates purpose, data, method, evaluation, limitations and intended use into the artefact markers look for
method: Standard model card structure adapted to a non-clinical decision-support tool
validation: Intended use and out-of-scope use both stated
kpi: Model card covers all deployed models
definition_of_done: Out-of-scope uses explicitly listed

task: Weekly reflective diary entries
reason: Directly assessed; generic entries score poorly, specific analytical decisions score well
method: Fixed 10-heading template tied to a specific decision each week
validation: Each entry names a specific dataset, number or model change
kpi: 1 entry per week, each citing a concrete analytical decision
definition_of_done: Entry written in-week, not backfilled
